notes: The supplied he bade them is a whole predicate with its own subject and object standing over a bare infinitive; no token of this verse licenses it, so it is added under rules 5 and 62, the ASV's italics corroborating.
διασῴζω → bring him safe heads on safe, the word rendering the σῴζω core (rule 66); bring answers to no element of the lexeme.
